introduction: New York Medicaid application routes depend on age and eligibility category. The marketplace and local districts serve different applicants.
description: New York Medicaid application routes depend on age and eligibility category. The marketplace and local districts serve different applicants.

sections.who: Income, household, age, disability and care needs affect eligibility. Some applicants over the basic income level can qualify through another pathway.
sections.get: Approved coverage depends on the program and notice. Ask about applicable health-plan and provider arrangements.
sections.docs:
• Household and income records.
  • Identity and requested eligibility evidence.
  • Insurance and medical-expense information where relevant.
sections.apply:
1. Choose the correct route

    Read Medicaid application guidance; most younger applicants use NY State of Health.

  2. Use local intake when needed

    Older, certified blind or disabled, and spenddown applicants may need district/HRA intake.

  3. Complete verification

    Provide requested proof and read the decision.
sections.after: Follow renewal and change-reporting instructions; confirm current rules with the administering office.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Medicaid applying; District application categories; Marketplace access. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.
